title: Odoo Printer Manager (ePOS Proxy)
description: Complete guide to installing ePOS Proxy, configuring printer drivers, and connecting printers to Odoo via USB or Ethernet.

blocks.text: Step 3: Configure the Printer in Odoo

blocks.html: When the printer connects to the ePOS Proxy application, an IP address will be displayed. Copy the IP using the Copy IP button.
Configure this printer in Odoo using the same procedure as is followed for EPSON printers.
Important: You must enable LNA (Local Network Access) in the ePOS Proxy application for the printer to communicate with Odoo.
For LAN printer connections (Ethernet), follow the dedicated network setup steps in this guide:

blocks.html: Open the ePOS Proxy app, click + Add Network Printer, enter the printer IP address (e.g. 192.168.192.168), and click Add.

blocks.text: Connect Multiple Printers with Your Laptop Using an Ethernet Cable

blocks.html: This setup is intended for environments where multiple printers are connected directly to a laptop through a network switch without a router.
To ensure connectivity, configure all hardware on the identical subnet with fixed IP addresses.

Primary Network Parameters
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.1.10
DNS Server: 8.8.8.8

blocks.text: Configure Printers One at a Time

blocks.html: Many printers ship with the same default static IP address. To avoid IP conflicts, configure each printer individually before connecting all printers to the switch.

items: Connect only one printer directly to the laptop using an Ethernet cable (do not connect through a router or switch).
Print a self-test page and note the printer's current IP address and network settings.
Open a web browser and navigate to the printer's IP address.

blocks.text: Connect the Printer to Your Laptop via the Router

blocks.html: This setup is intended for environments where multiple printers are connected to the same router as the laptop.
Important: Reserve a fixed IP address for each printer within the router's network range. This ensures the printers always receive the same IP address and remain accessible through the router.
For example, if the router's network uses the range 192.168.1.1 – 192.168.1.255, assign or reserve IP addresses such as:

Primary Network Parameters
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.1.1
DNS Server: 8.8.8.8

blocks.text: Configure Printers One at a Time

blocks.html: Many printers ship with the same default static IP address. To avoid IP conflicts, configure each printer individually before connecting all printers to the router.

items: Connect only one printer directly to the laptop using an Ethernet cable (do not connect through a router or switch).
Print a self-test page and note the printer's current IP address and network settings.
Check whether DHCP is enabled on the printer in the self-test page.

blocks.html: Reserve a fixed IP address for the printer in the router and proceed to the next printer.

Important Note — Ethernet Connection Between Printer and Router: For reliable operation, keep an always-on device (like a computer) connected to the same wired Ethernet network as the printer. Some network setups may cause the printer to become unreachable after being idle for a short time if there is no active device on the network.
